manifest_purpose: Registry of agents the orchestrator can dispatch. Maps the logical agent name to the subagent_type and the dispatch matrix entry. Keep this in sync with maestro-docs/maestro-orchestrator-guide.md §1.
convention: The agent's logical name (the human-facing role) and its subagent_type (the string passed to the task tool) are recorded separately because the opencode runtime requires the kebab-case form while the orchestrator's plans and handoffs use the human-readable form.

production.name: Senior Developer
production.role: Implements code per task spec and TDD suite. Java/Android, Kotlin/Compose for TV, NDK/JNI, streaming protocol. Activates tests one at a time (red to green), refactors while green, updates handoff with implementation evidence.

production.name: QA Architect
production.role: Creates TDD red-phase test scaffolds before implementation. Runs coverage audits with Memtrace reconciliation after implementation. Gates tasks between development and UAT.

production.name: DevOps Architect
production.role: Podman-first container design, GitHub Actions CI, self-hosted runners, device lab, signing, release engineering.

production.name: Security Analyst
production.role: Threat modeling, supply chain policy, secrets management, signing policy, incident response, DevSecOps design.

production.name: GRC Architect
production.role: ADR governance, compliance checks, waiver management, policy enforcement, audit trails. Ensures no undocumented decision affects the product boundary.

production.name: Tech Writer
production.role: Documents every artifact, creates session handouts to prevent context rot, maintains handoff file with finalized information. In the post-phase session, also consolidates all per-task artifacts and produces the session handout.

production.name: UX/UI Designer
production.role: Visual design system, TV UX patterns, accessibility, D-pad flows, Compose for TV evaluation.

review.name: Blind Hunter
review.role: Cynical adversarial reviewer with zero context. Finds what is missing, not just what is wrong. Returns at least 10 issues per review.

review.name: Edge Case Hunter
review.role: Exhaustive path enumeration, boundary conditions, deletion check. Method-driven, not attitude-driven.

review.name: Acceptance Analyst
review.role: Reviews diff against spec and acceptance criteria. Finds deviations from spec intent.

review.name: Red Team Analyst
review.role: Offensive security reviewer. Finds exploitable weaknesses with concrete attack scenarios using STRIDE and OWASP.

review.name: Blue Team Analyst
review.role: Defensive security reviewer. Receives red team findings and designs concrete, implementable mitigations. Assesses exploitability, confirms or rejects findings, checks for new risks introduced by mitigations.

post_phase_session_dispatch_order.description: Order in which the 4 architects are dispatched in the post-phase session. Two parallel pairs (grc+security in parallel, qa+devops in parallel) is the recommended default; sequential dispatch is the fallback if the runtime does not support parallel dispatch.

phase_2.note: Blue team receives red team findings as input. Sequential by design.
